turns.question: How much revenue did we make per site session between 20 September and 3 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no revenue-per-session metric, so I won't divide the two myself; the closest metrics are Revenue (EUR) and Site sessions, which for 2026-09-20 to 2026-10-03 were EUR 7,172.59 revenue and 10 site sessions.
